scheme_name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Free Distribution of Bicycles
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
other_conditions: Must be a girl student studying in class VIII in a government or government‑aided school of the UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
benefits_summary: Free bicycles are provided to all girl students of class VIII in government or government‑aided schools of the UT.
